units.displayText: There is another Doll by Hatsuchiri's side. He looks very gaunt and pale, yet he's standing upright.

units.rawText: You must be the Professor. Nice to meet you, I'm Sueyoi.
units.displayText: You must be the Professor. Nice to meet you, I'm Sueyoi.

spans.text: You must be the Professor. Nice to meet you, I'm Sueyoi.

units.rawText: Let's dispense with the handshake. My condition makes it inadvisable for me to touch others.
units.displayText: Let's dispense with the handshake. My condition makes it inadvisable for me to touch others.

spans.text: Let's dispense with the handshake. My condition makes it inadvisable for me to touch others.

units.rawText: He shows me his arm. It's covered in Entropy-infected wounds.
units.displayText: He shows me his arm. It's covered in Entropy-infected wounds.

spans.text: He shows me his arm. It's covered in Entropy-infected wounds.

units.rawText: The Entropization has nearly reached the intermediate stage. Do you want treatment from the Oasis?
units.displayText: The Entropization has nearly reached the intermediate stage. Do you want treatment from the Oasis?

spans.text: The Entropization has nearly reached the intermediate stage. Do you want treatment from the Oasis?

units.rawText: Aw, thank you for your concern, Nana! But we need to be heading back soon.
units.displayText: Aw, thank you for your concern, Nana! But we need to be heading back soon.

spans.text: Aw, thank you for your concern, Nana! But we need to be heading back soon.

units.rawText: Uh... You've obtained a sample of Demiurge's source code, haven't you? If you could spare us a copy, we could perform treatment afterward!
units.displayText: Uh... You've obtained a sample of Demiurge's source code, haven't you? If you could spare us a copy, we could perform treatment afterward!

spans.text: Uh... You've obtained a sample of Demiurge's source code, haven't you? If you could spare us a copy, we could perform treatment afterward!

units.rawText: De Lacey swishes her tail as she looks at me. I find myself yielding to her imploring gaze.
units.displayText: De Lacey swishes her tail as she looks at me. I find myself yielding to her imploring gaze.

spans.text: De Lacey swishes her tail as she looks at me. I find myself yielding to her imploring gaze.

units.rawText: Of course we can.
units.displayText: Of course we can.

spans.text: Of course we can.

units.rawText: Sueyoi... yeah? Are you really okay? You look terrible.
units.displayText: Sueyoi... yeah? Are you really okay? You look terrible.

spans.text: Sueyoi... yeah? Are you really okay? You look terrible.

units.rawText: I'm fine, no need to worry...
units.displayText: I'm fine, no need to worry...

spans.text: I'm fine, no need to worry...

units.rawText: Chirp!
units.displayText: Chirp!

spans.text: Chirp!

units.rawText: Sueyoi's legs suddenly give out. He is only saved from collapsing because Hatsuchiri grabs him just in time.
units.displayText: Sueyoi's legs suddenly give out. He is only saved from collapsing because Hatsuchiri grabs him just in time.

spans.text: Sueyoi's legs suddenly give out. He is only saved from collapsing because Hatsuchiri grabs him just in time.

units.rawText: Don't push yourself. You're very weak.
units.displayText: Don't push yourself. You're very weak.

spans.text: Don't push yourself. You're very weak.

units.rawText: I'm fine, mind your own business. What hit me just now?
units.displayText: I'm fine, mind your own business. What hit me just now?

spans.text: I'm fine, mind your own business. What hit me just now?

units.rawText: Something's coming out of the sea!
units.displayText: Something's coming out of the sea!

spans.text: Something's coming out of the sea!

units.rawText: Sol draws her blades. Just then, something bursts out of the water with lightning speed and lunges at Antonina—
units.displayText: Sol draws her blades. Just then, something bursts out of the water with lightning speed and lunges at Antonina—

spans.text: Sol draws her blades. Just then, something bursts out of the water with lightning speed and lunges at Antonina—

units.rawText: ...Ugh! I can't avoid it...
units.displayText: ...Ugh! I can't avoid it...

spans.text: ...Ugh! I can't avoid it...

units.rawText: Chirp—
units.displayText: Chirp—

spans.text: Chirp—

units.rawText: As everyone watches, the Entropic which has escaped notice rushes to Antonina's side—
units.displayText: As everyone watches, the Entropic which has escaped notice rushes to Antonina's side—

spans.text: As everyone watches, the Entropic which has escaped notice rushes to Antonina's side—

units.rawText: And clings tightly to her calf with all its feelers.
units.displayText: And clings tightly to her calf with all its feelers.

spans.text: And clings tightly to her calf with all its feelers.

units.rawText: Ehhhhh!?
units.displayText: Ehhhhh!?

spans.text: Ehhhhh!?

units.rawText: Don't hurt Antonina!
units.displayText: Don't hurt Antonina!

spans.text: Don't hurt Antonina!

units.rawText: Wait a minute, Sol... It... It's not trying to steal my operands.
units.displayText: Wait a minute, Sol... It... It's not trying to steal my operands.

spans.text: Wait a minute, Sol... It... It's not trying to steal my operands.

units.rawText: Huh? Did your stockings block it or something?
units.displayText: Huh? Did your stockings block it or something?

spans.text: Huh? Did your stockings block it or something?

units.rawText: Don't be ridiculous.
units.displayText: Don't be ridiculous.

spans.text: Don't be ridiculous.

units.rawText: Antonina plucks the diminutive Entropic from her calf. It puts up no resistance at all and simply wraps its feelers around Antonina's wrist.
units.displayText: Antonina plucks the diminutive Entropic from her calf. It puts up no resistance at all and simply wraps its feelers around Antonina's wrist.

spans.text: Antonina plucks the diminutive Entropic from her calf. It puts up no resistance at all and simply wraps its feelers around Antonina's wrist.

units.rawText: It's not sucking my operands even though it's clinging to my wrist.
units.displayText: It's not sucking my operands even though it's clinging to my wrist.

spans.text: It's not sucking my operands even though it's clinging to my wrist.

units.rawText: <size=28>Didn't you just test my hypothesis...</size>
units.displayText: Didn't you just test my hypothesis...

spans.text: Didn't you just test my hypothesis...

units.rawText: Isn't this... the tiny little Entropic creature that Demiurge was always carrying around in her feelers?
units.displayText: Isn't this... the tiny little Entropic creature that Demiurge was always carrying around in her feelers?

spans.text: Isn't this... the tiny little Entropic creature that Demiurge was always carrying around in her feelers?

units.rawText: It DOES look like it! I guess it eluded the Sanctifiers' detection because she protected it.
units.displayText: It DOES look like it! I guess it eluded the Sanctifiers' detection because she protected it.

spans.text: It DOES look like it! I guess it eluded the Sanctifiers' detection because she protected it.

units.rawText: Maybe Demiurge thought of it as her own child.
units.displayText: Maybe Demiurge thought of it as her own child.

spans.text: Maybe Demiurge thought of it as her own child.

units.rawText: Yet another human-like reason again? You should stop with your fantasies, Hatsuchiri.
units.displayText: Yet another human-like reason again? You should stop with your fantasies, Hatsuchiri.

spans.text: Yet another human-like reason again? You should stop with your fantasies, Hatsuchiri.

units.rawText: In any case, there's no harm in keeping it around as a research specimen.
units.displayText: In any case, there's no harm in keeping it around as a research specimen.

spans.text: In any case, there's no harm in keeping it around as a research specimen.

units.rawText: At the very least, it seems pretty friendly with Antonina. What do you think, Professor?
units.displayText: At the very least, it seems pretty friendly with Antonina. What do you think, Professor?

spans.text: At the very least, it seems pretty friendly with Antonina. What do you think, Professor?
It's too dangerous.
Sure, why not?

units.rawText: I think keeping it for the time being should be alright. Compared to the static source code, this ever-changing live specimen would be more conducive to our research.
units.displayText: I think keeping it for the time being should be alright. Compared to the static source code, this ever-changing live specimen would be more conducive to our research.

spans.text: I think keeping it for the time being should be alright. Compared to the static source code, this ever-changing live specimen would be more conducive to our research.

units.rawText: I would like to keep it, Professor.
units.displayText: I would like to keep it, Professor.

spans.text: I would like to keep it, Professor.

units.rawText: Well, Anna the pro has spoken. If we bring this little guy back, we'll be able to figure out a solution more quickly and wake Croque and the others up sooner, right?
units.displayText: Well, Anna the pro has spoken. If we bring this little guy back, we'll be able to figure out a solution more quickly and wake Croque and the others up sooner, right?

spans.text: Well, Anna the pro has spoken. If we bring this little guy back, we'll be able to figure out a solution more quickly and wake Croque and the others up sooner, right?

units.rawText: I cannot argue with that.
units.displayText: I cannot argue with that.

spans.text: I cannot argue with that.

units.rawText: Sueyoi exchanges silent looks with De Lacey and Hatsuchiri.
units.displayText: Sueyoi exchanges silent looks with De Lacey and Hatsuchiri.

spans.text: Sueyoi exchanges silent looks with De Lacey and Hatsuchiri.

units.rawText: Letting the Oasis handle it seems like a pretty good idea.
units.displayText: Letting the Oasis handle it seems like a pretty good idea.

spans.text: Letting the Oasis handle it seems like a pretty good idea.

units.rawText: It's actually kinda cute when you look at it...
units.displayText: It's actually kinda cute when you look at it...

spans.text: It's actually kinda cute when you look at it...

units.rawText: If it's not hostile, can I poke it?
units.displayText: If it's not hostile, can I poke it?

spans.text: If it's not hostile, can I poke it?

units.rawText: Chirp!!
units.displayText: Chirp!!

spans.text: Chirp!!

units.rawText: So it only lets Anna touch it? How come even Entropics show discrimination?
units.displayText: So it only lets Anna touch it? How come even Entropics show discrimination?

spans.text: So it only lets Anna touch it? How come even Entropics show discrimination?

units.rawText: It's kind of slimy and gooey to have an Entropic on my hand... Would you want a "privilege" like that?
units.displayText: It's kind of slimy and gooey to have an Entropic on my hand... Would you want a "privilege" like that?

spans.text: It's kind of slimy and gooey to have an Entropic on my hand... Would you want a "privilege" like that?

units.rawText: Sueyoi does not take part in this increasingly farcical banter and walks over to me.
units.displayText: Sueyoi does not take part in this increasingly farcical banter and walks over to me.

spans.text: Sueyoi does not take part in this increasingly farcical banter and walks over to me.

units.rawText: I don't even know what to say.
units.displayText: I don't even know what to say.

spans.text: I don't even know what to say.

units.rawText: Professor of the Oasis, do you approve of something this ridiculous?
units.displayText: Professor of the Oasis, do you approve of something this ridiculous?

spans.text: Professor of the Oasis, do you approve of something this ridiculous?

units.rawText: Many of the agents at the Oasis are infected, and while we've obtained the source code, having an Entropic creature as a specimen would be extra insurance for us.
units.displayText: Many of the agents at the Oasis are infected, and while we've obtained the source code, having an Entropic creature as a specimen would be extra insurance for us.

spans.text: Many of the agents at the Oasis are infected, and while we've obtained the source code, having an Entropic creature as a specimen would be extra insurance for us.

units.rawText: So you're taking risks for your friends... Fair enough.
units.displayText: So you're taking risks for your friends... Fair enough.

spans.text: So you're taking risks for your friends... Fair enough.

units.rawText: ...I have another question for you.
units.displayText: ...I have another question for you.

spans.text: ...I have another question for you.

units.rawText: What kind of place is the Oasis? What do you fight for?
units.displayText: What kind of place is the Oasis? What do you fight for?

spans.text: What kind of place is the Oasis? What do you fight for?

options.rawText: We seek to uncover the cause of this disaster.
options.displayText: We seek to uncover the cause of this disaster.

spans.text: We seek to uncover the cause of this disaster.

options.rawText: We fight to free our agents from Magrasea.
options.displayText: We fight to free our agents from Magrasea.

spans.text: We fight to free our agents from Magrasea.
I can't tell you.

units.rawText: Really now. All the best, then.
units.displayText: Really now. All the best, then.

spans.text: Really now. All the best, then.

units.rawText: Will the outside world be better? I don't think so.
units.displayText: Will the outside world be better? I don't think so.

spans.text: Will the outside world be better? I don't think so.

units.rawText: That's fine.
units.displayText: That's fine.

spans.text: That's fine.

units.rawText: While Oasis walks a different path from the Guardians...
units.displayText: While Oasis walks a different path from the Guardians...

spans.text: While Oasis walks a different path from the
Guardians...

units.rawText: Some of my... personal aims coincide with yours.
units.displayText: Some of my... personal aims coincide with yours.

spans.text: Some of my... personal aims coincide with yours.

units.rawText: When the time comes, perhaps we might work together again.
units.displayText: When the time comes, perhaps we might work together again.

spans.text: When the time comes, perhaps we might work together again.

options.rawText: I look forward to that day.
options.displayText: I look forward to that day.

spans.text: I look forward to that day.
I don't think so.

units.rawText: Let's part ways here, then.
units.displayText: Let's part ways here, then.

spans.text: Let's part ways here, then.

units.rawText: The Exiles leave, and Sueyoi and company have also traveled some distance away.
units.displayText: The Exiles leave, and Sueyoi and company have also traveled some distance away.

spans.text: The Exiles leave, and Sueyoi and company have also traveled some distance away.

units.rawText: The sunlight simulated by the cloud server is exceptionally dazzling, and Sueyoi unconsciously shades his eyes with his hand as he looks back in the direction where he parted ways with the Exiles.
units.displayText: The sunlight simulated by the cloud server is exceptionally dazzling, and Sueyoi unconsciously shades his eyes with his hand as he looks back in the direction where he parted ways with the Exiles.

spans.text: The sunlight simulated by the cloud server is exceptionally dazzling, and Sueyoi unconsciously shades his eyes with his hand as he looks back in the direction where he parted ways with the Exiles.

units.rawText: Are you looking at Demiurge, Succhy?
units.displayText: Are you looking at Demiurge, Succhy?

spans.text: Are you looking at Demiurge, Succhy?

units.rawText: Sueyoi turns away.
units.displayText: Sueyoi turns away.

spans.text: Sueyoi turns away.

units.rawText: No, I'm looking at our future path.
units.displayText: No, I'm looking at our future path.

spans.text: No, I'm looking at our future path.

units.rawText: Since we've regrouped, we ought to press on and carry out our top priority order—
units.displayText: Since we've regrouped, we ought to press on and carry out our top priority order—

spans.text: Since we've regrouped, we ought to press on and carry out our top priority order—

units.rawText: Sueyoi suddenly collapses.
units.displayText: Sueyoi suddenly collapses.

spans.text: Sueyoi suddenly collapses.

units.rawText: Succhy!?
units.displayText: Succhy!?

spans.text: Succhy!?

units.rawText: Let him rest for a bit.
units.displayText: Let him rest for a bit.

spans.text: Let him rest for a bit.

units.rawText: Hatsuchiri supports Sueyoi and props him up against a nearby tree.
units.displayText: Hatsuchiri supports Sueyoi and props him up against a nearby tree.

spans.text: Hatsuchiri supports Sueyoi and props him up against a nearby tree.

units.rawText: Give me 10 minutes to recover, then we'll set out again.
units.displayText: Give me 10 minutes to recover, then we'll set out again.

spans.text: Give me 10 minutes to recover, then we'll set out again.

units.rawText: Yeah, after all, we Guardians still have our mission to complete. But before that, let's get the source code home and take a break.
units.displayText: Yeah, after all, we Guardians still have our mission to complete. But before that, let's get the source code home and take a break.

spans.text: Yeah, after all, we
Guardians
still have our mission to complete. But before that, let's get the source code home and take a break.

units.rawText: ...Alright, then.
units.displayText: ...Alright, then.

spans.text: ...Alright, then.

units.rawText: Sueyoi once again looks back at the way he came and lets out a derisive chuckle.
units.displayText: Sueyoi once again looks back at the way he came and lets out a derisive chuckle.

spans.text: Sueyoi once again looks back at the way he came and lets out a derisive chuckle.

units.rawText: ...Everything is <color=orange>[For Arcadia]</color>.
units.displayText: ...Everything is [For Arcadia].

[For Arcadia]

63.name: Guardians
63.description: A mysterious organization to which Hatsuchiri, Sueyoi, and De Lacey belong. They have a different objective from Oasis and are known for their slogan, "For Arcadia."
